title: Celestial Journey
subtitle: 天空の旅
logline: A burnt-out night-shift worker in neon cyberpunk Tokyo finally keeps an old promise: to see the sunrise at Mount Fuji. Night is stylized; dawn is real.
style: cinematic cyberpunk Tokyo at night, neon magenta and cyan, wet reflective streets, light rain, volumetric haze, holographic signs in Japanese, anamorphic lens flares, shallow depth of field, 35mm film grain, moody, highly detailed
negative: text, watermark, logo, extra fingers, deformed hands, distorted face, warped wheels, cartoon, lowres, blurry, oversaturated, duplicate person
character: a young Japanese woman in her mid twenties, short black bob haircut with blunt bangs, small silver hoop earring, oversized black techwear jacket with reflective trim, white over-ear headphones, tired gentle eyes
car: a sleek midnight-purple Japanese sports coupe, wide body, low stance, full-width red LED taillight bar, sharp LED headlights, glossy paint

timeline.desc: 2am. She steps out of a back door into a neon alley, rain falling. Wide.
timeline.image: wide shot, {character} stepping out of a steel back door into a narrow neon alley at 2am, rain, steam from vents, puddles reflecting pink and cyan signs
timeline.motion: she walks slowly toward camera, rain falling, neon flickers, steam drifts

timeline.desc: Close-up: she puts on her headphones. Neon in her tired eyes.
timeline.image: close-up portrait of {character}, putting on headphones, neon reflections in her eyes, raindrops on her jacket, exhausted expression
timeline.motion: she slowly lifts headphones over her ears and closes her eyes for a moment, subtle head movement

timeline.desc: From behind: she walks through a holographic street, alone in the crowd.
timeline.image: from behind, {character} walking alone through a crowded holographic shopping street, giant floating hologram signs, rain, crowd blurred
timeline.motion: camera follows behind her as she walks, crowd moves past in slow motion, holograms shimmer

timeline.desc: Her hand on the door handle of the coupe, rain beading on purple paint.
timeline.image: macro close-up of a woman's hand opening the door handle of {car}, raindrops beading on the paint reflecting neon
timeline.motion: hand pulls the door handle, door opens slightly, raindrops slide down the paint

timeline.desc: Inside the car: hands on the wheel, dashboard glow, the old photo tucked in the visor.
timeline.image: interior of {car} at night, {character} in the driver seat with hands on the steering wheel, glowing dashboard, an old instant photo of two friends tucked in the sun visor, rain on the windshield
timeline.motion: she glances up at the photo in the visor, takes a breath, rain streaks down the windshield

timeline.desc: Close-up of the photo: two friends at Lake Kawaguchi, Fuji behind. Handwritten: 'sunrise, together'.
timeline.image: close-up of an old faded instant photo tucked in a car sun visor, two young women laughing at a lake with Mount Fuji behind them, neon light from outside falling across it
timeline.motion: very slow push in on the photo, neon light slides across it

timeline.desc: BUILD. The coupe pulls out. Low rear tracking shot, taillight bar glowing.
timeline.image: low rear tracking shot of {car} pulling out onto a wet neon street at night, red taillight bar glowing, spray from the tires
timeline.motion: car accelerates away from camera, neon signs blur past, water sprays from tires

timeline.desc: Drone: the coupe on an elevated expressway through holographic towers.
timeline.image: aerial drone shot of {car} driving on an elevated highway at night between towering cyberpunk skyscrapers with giant holograms, light trails
timeline.motion: drone follows the car from above and behind, city lights stream past

timeline.desc: BREAKDOWN. She stops on a bridge, stands at the railing, city behind her.
timeline.image: wide shot, {character} standing alone at the railing of a bridge at night, {car} parked behind her, glowing cyberpunk skyline across the bay, calm water reflecting lights
timeline.motion: wind moves her hair and jacket, city lights twinkle, very slow camera drift

timeline.desc: Close-up: she holds the photo. A tear. A memory.
timeline.image: close-up of {character} holding an old instant photo, a single tear on her cheek, city lights bokeh behind her, blue night light
timeline.motion: she looks down at the photo, then slowly up toward the horizon

timeline.desc: Determination: she gets back in and grips the wheel.
timeline.image: close-up of {character} gripping the steering wheel, determined eyes, neon reflections across her face, inside {car}
timeline.motion: her grip tightens, she exhales and looks forward, engine glow

timeline.desc: DROP. The coupe launches. Tires spray, neon explodes past.
timeline.image: dynamic side tracking shot of {car} launching down a neon street at night, motion blur, water spraying from tires, pink and cyan light streaks
timeline.motion: car launches forward at high speed, intense motion blur, light streaks

timeline.desc: The coupe slices through a holographic Shibuya-style crossing under a giant hologram koi.
timeline.image: {car} speeding through a giant scramble crossing at night surrounded by holographic billboards, a huge hologram koi fish swimming through the air above, crowds
timeline.motion: car crosses the intersection at speed, hologram koi swims overhead, crowds blur

timeline.desc: Inside: for the first time, she smiles. City light streams across her face.
timeline.image: {character} driving at night with a small genuine smile, colorful city light streaming across her face through the window, headphones on
timeline.motion: light streams across her face, she smiles softly, slight head nod to the music

timeline.desc: TUNNEL. The coupe heads into a glowing tunnel mouth.
timeline.image: {car} driving toward the glowing entrance of an underground highway tunnel at night, orange tunnel lights, cyberpunk city above
timeline.motion: car drives into the tunnel, lights begin streaking over the bodywork

timeline.desc: Inner journey: her face in rainbow tunnel light, eyes closed, serene.
timeline.image: close-up of {character} with eyes closed and a serene expression, face lit by shifting rainbow light from a tunnel, surreal dreamy atmosphere
timeline.motion: rainbow light flows across her face, hair floats slightly as if weightless

timeline.desc: EXIT. The coupe bursts out of the tunnel into golden dawn.
timeline.image: {car} bursting out of a tunnel exit into golden sunrise light, huge lens flare, morning mist, mountains ahead
timeline.motion: car exits the tunnel toward camera into blinding sunrise light, lens flare blooms

timeline.desc: She stands at Lake Kawaguchi at sunrise, takes off her headphones, holds the photo up to the real Fuji.
timeline.image: {character} standing at the shore of a calm lake at sunrise holding up an old instant photo that matches Mount Fuji behind it, golden light on her face, peaceful smile
timeline.motion: she lowers her headphones, raises the photo to line up with the mountain, smiles as sunlight hits her face
